value.account: Added optional schema-2.1 profile validation and atomic pure visit/settlement transactions; selected the profile for new typed public .orc roots and eligible fresh Workflow Lisp call frames while preserving existing roots, frames, failed predecessors, and force-restart source bytes. Added a scope-local typed dependency index, literal/ref and union validation, exact progress witnesses, cache-authority checks, durable-input validation, and read-only conflict audits. Integrated replay before prologue/effects, retained full active results only in memory, suppressed eligible bundles/private lineage/checkpoints, filtered checkpoint candidates, and admitted validated frame-entry replay with durable ownership. Resume determines its boundary once, and observation managers now follow execution lifetime. Updated specs/state.md and behavioral tests. Considered stripping ordinary serialized results, retaining pure checkpoint authority, and treating every pure node as eligible; discarded those approaches because they permit value leakage, trust redundant durable values, or break recurrent/iteration-owned persistence. Reused existing typed contracts and evaluator without new dependencies or serialized-plan changes. Independent review fixes cover call-boundary checkpoint ownership, missing prior pure authority, historical guard ordering, union typing, and observation-manager reuse. Verification: 929 related tests passed using pytest -q -n 16 --dist=worksteal in tmux; 158 affected cases collected; compile and whitespace checks passed. Interruption smoke tests confirm identical outputs, visit-one reuse, and no committed-effect redispatch. Did not run the entire repository suite, live provider jobs, or performance benchmarks; historical runs are intentionally not migrated.
